display_name: The Holy Woman and her Holy Infant

names.form: Αγία Γυναίκα και το Άγιο Βρέφος της
names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Οκτωβρίου, «Αγία Γυναίκα και το Άγιο Βρέφος της». The page names neither of them at all, so the form is the line itself.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Οκτωβρίου — «Αγία Γυναίκα και το Άγιο Βρέφος της»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2529/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **Neither of the two is named on the page**, so no name form can be read for either and the entry is kept as one folder for the pair, after the pattern of `thirty-three-martyrs-of-heraclea`; `sex` is `unknown` for the same reason. The page ties them to Arethas of Nagran — «μαρτύρησαν μαζί με τον Άγιο Αρέθα» — whose folder exists and is upgraded on this day, so the `related` row goes there. It gives no year and no city; the reign of Justin (518–527) and the kings Elesbaan and Dounaan stand on Arethas's page and not on this one, so no `dates` object is proposed here. No hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
